text.zh: 摊开手掌看一眼。这只手上有 27 块骨头，两只手加起来 54 块，占全身 206 块骨头的四分之一还多。
text.en: Open your palm and look. There are 27 bones in this one hand — 54 in the pair, more than a quarter of all 206 bones you own.

text.zh: 手掌和手指占了 19 块，排成 5 列。除拇指外每一列都能单独弯，拇指则能横过掌心去够其余 4 指——这才有了捏、勾、握、弹。
text.en: Palm and fingers account for nineteen, in five columns. Every column but the thumb bends on its own, while the thumb swings across the palm to meet the other four — hence pinching, hooking, gripping, flicking.

text.zh: 剩下 8 块全挤在手腕，个个只有骰子大小。手腕转得动，靠的不是某一个关节，而是这 8 块彼此让出的那点缝。
text.en: The remaining eight crowd into the wrist, each no bigger than a dice. The wrist turns not on any single joint but on the slivers of space these eight give one another.

text.zh: 往上接着的是桡骨。你现在把手掌翻过来试试——手腕一点没转，是这根骨头在前臂里画了半个圈。
text.en: Above it comes the radius. Turn your palm over right now — the wrist never rotated at all; this one bone just swept half a circle inside your forearm.

text.zh: 它绕的那根轴就是尺骨。尺骨上端牢牢卡进肘关节，几乎纹丝不动，一动一静，掌心才翻得过来。
text.en: The axle it swings around is the ulna, whose upper end is locked so firmly into the elbow that it barely shifts. One bone turning, one holding still — that is how the palm flips over.

text.zh: 手指本身几乎没有肌肉。握拳时前臂的指浅屈肌先出力，它弯的是手指中间那一节，靠长长的肌腱远程拉动。
text.en: The fingers themselves carry almost no muscle. In a fist, flexor digitorum superficialis in the forearm pulls first, bending the middle joint of each finger through long, slender tendons.

text.zh: 前臂背面的指伸肌负责把手指拉直。手指之所以细，正因为发动机全都装在了远处。
text.en: On the back of the forearm, extensor digitorum pulls the fingers straight again. Fingers stay slim precisely because their engines are installed so far away.

text.zh: 再往上只剩肱骨一根。越靠近身体骨头越少越粗，越靠近指尖越多越细——手就是这样一路分岔出来的。
text.en: Higher up, only the humerus remains. Bones grow fewer and thicker towards the body, more numerous and finer towards the fingertips — the hand branches out along the way.

text.zh: 27 块骨头、几十条从远处拉过来的肌腱，凑成一只既能穿针、又能提起箱子的手。
text.en: Twenty-seven bones and dozens of tendons pulled in from a distance make a hand that can thread a needle and also lift a suitcase.
